description: The workbench window. Its only granted capability is Tauri's event IPC, which is exactly listen and unlisten — the pair the backend adapter subscribes a listener with. The dialog plugin is linked so the HOST can open the OS folder picker from dispatch, but no dialog:* permission is granted to this window, so the WebView has no plugin command to call; every host answer is reached over the IPC and gated by the session registry in src/session.rs.
